engineeringCommits.subject: Bound Android CI test workers and retain the last started test
Handle PostgreSQL disconnects throughout storage pool checkouts
Reject database outages and read-only replicas in API readiness

soak.environment: WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04, 2 API and 2 realtime, round-robin calls and recipient gateways, PostgreSQL 16.15, Ubuntu Redis 7.0.15, two CPU affinity shared with local generator, loopback, ordinary quotas
soak.arrivalModel: Open arrivals. Ten synthetic accounts, five WebSocket recipients distributed between the gateways. Two API, two Realtime, Redis and PostgreSQL on WSL2. Application and generator on two logical CPUs. Eight admitted operations in flight and three seconds for delivery.

hostCpu.basis: Five-second process CPU samples on the WSL2 lab. 100% is one logical CPU. PostgreSQL totals count processes observed in both samples. PSI is guest-wide.

postgresqlFailover.topology: Dedicated WSL2 PostgreSQL 16.15 primary and physical synchronous standby, both loopback; one persistent API and Realtime process, internal TCP relay explicitly switched after fencing and promotion
postgresqlFailover.preciseOutage: immediate stop of the owned temporary primary data directory

uploadPool.image: PostgreSQL 16.15 in a dedicated temporary database and Linux Node 22.23.5

productEntryPoint.transport: Private native Docker Engine and Compose, isolated Linux network namespace; API uses its normal DNS route to the converter, a restricted DB login and its production entrypoint. Test secrets and files only.
